recipe.title: Sheet Pan Chicken Shawarma
recipe.note: When ready to cook (after marinating chicken) preheat oven to 425 degrees and lightly oil sheet pan with oil/Pam or line with non-stick foil.
recipe.ingredients:
4 tbsp olive oil
2 tbsp lemon juice
4 cloves garlic
2 tsp coriander
2 tsp paprika
2 tsp cumin
1 tsp tumeric
1 tsp salt
1/2 tsp cinnamon
1/2 tsp ginger
1/4 tsp cardamon
dash of cayenne
4 large boneless skinless chicken breasts

actions.text: Mix marinade ingredients in large ziploc bag.
Cut up chicken into thin strips.
Add chicken to marinade and keep in fridge for min 2 hours.

Remove chicken from fridge and place in a single layer on prepared sheet pan. Drizzle any remaining marinade over chicken.  Bake for 25 minutes, flipping chicken once after 15 minutes.  Serve with Morrocan couscous.
